item.title: The US flu season is off to a very early start. It's targeting the South and West now
item.description: The U.S. flu season is off to a very early start, and it’s quickly intensifying. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on Friday posted its latest update, reporting that seven states were reporting high flu activity last week, up from two the week before.
